```{r fun-group-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# GROUPED TABLE WITH P-VALUES
##################################
# create condition variable that has empty stratum
s1.pass$group = NA
s1.pass$group <- factor(s1.pass$condition.n, levels = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Critical", "Control", "P-value"))

# function
rndr <- function(x, name, ...) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {
        y <- s1.pass[[name]]
        s <- rep("", length(render.default(x = y, name = name, ...)))
        if (is.numeric(y)) {
            p <- t.test(y ~ s1.pass$group)$p.value
        } else {
            p <- chisq.test(table(y, droplevels(s1.pass$group)))$p.value
        }
        s[2] <- sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        s
    } else {
        render.default(x = x, name = name, ...)
    }
}

rndr.strat <- function(label, n, ...) {
    ifelse(n == 0, label, render.strat.default(label, n, ...))
}

# individual & critical #
# create 2 level condition variable for each comparison
s1.pass$condition.icrit = NA
s1.pass$condition.icrit[s1.pass$condition == "Individual"] <- "Individual"
s1.pass$condition.icrit[s1.pass$condition == "Critical"] <- "Critical"
s1.pass$condition.icrit <- factor(s1.pass$condition.icrit, exclude = NA)

# create condition variable that has empty stratum
s1.pass$group.icrit    <- factor(as.numeric(s1.pass$condition.icrit), levels = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Critical", "Individual", "P-value"))
##freq(s1.pass$group)

# function
rndr.icrit <- function(x, name, ...) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {
        y <- s1.pass[[name]]
        s <- rep("", length(render.default(x = y, name = name, ...)))
        if (is.numeric(y)) {
            p <- t.test(y ~ s1.pass$group.icrit)$p.value
        } else {
            p <- chisq.test(table(y, droplevels(s1.pass$group.icrit)))$p.value
        }
        s[2] <- sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        s
    } else {
        render.default(x = x, name = name, ...)
    }
}


rndr.icrit.strat <- function(label, n, ...) {
    ifelse(n == 0, label, render.strat.default(label, n, ...))
}

# control & individual #
s1.pass$condition.ci = NA
s1.pass$condition.ci[s1.pass$condition == "Control"] <- "Control"
s1.pass$condition.ci[s1.pass$condition == "Individual"] <- "Individual"
s1.pass$condition.ci <- factor(s1.pass$condition.ci, exclude = NA)

s1.pass$group.ci    <- factor(as.numeric(s1.pass$condition.ci), levels = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Control", "Individual", "P-value"))

rndr.ci <- function(x, name, ...) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {
        y <- s1.pass[[name]]
        s <- rep("", length(render.default(x = y, name = name, ...)))
        if (is.numeric(y)) {
            p <- t.test(y ~ s1.pass$group.ci)$p.value
        } else {
            p <- chisq.test(table(y, droplevels(s1.pass$group.ci)))$p.value
        }
        s[2] <- sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        s
    } else {
        render.default(x = x, name = name, ...)
    }
}

rndr.ci.strat <- function(label, n, ...) {
    ifelse(n == 0, label, render.strat.default(label, n, ...))
}


# control & critical #
s1.pass$condition.ccrit = NA
s1.pass$condition.ccrit[s1.pass$condition == "Control"] <- "Control"
s1.pass$condition.ccrit[s1.pass$condition == "Critical"] <- "Critical"
s1.pass$condition.ccrit <- as.factor(s1.pass$condition.ccrit)

s1.pass$group.ccrit    <- factor(as.numeric(s1.pass$condition.ccrit), levels = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Critical", "Control", "P-value"))

rndr.ccrit <- function(x, name, ...) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {
        y <- s1.pass[[name]]
        s <- rep("", length(render.default(x = y, name = name, ...)))
        if (is.numeric(y)) {
            p <- t.test(y ~ s1.pass$group.ccrit)$p.value
        } else {
            p <- chisq.test(table(y, droplevels(s1.pass$group.ccrit)))$p.value
        }
        s[2] <- sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        s
    } else {
        render.default(x = x, name = name, ...)
    }
}

rndr.ccrit.strat <- function(label, n, ...) {
    ifelse(n == 0, label, render.strat.default(label, n, ...))
}
```

```{r keys-compare-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# COMPARISON GROUPS ---------------------------
# s1.pass
compare_s1.pass <- list(c("Critical", "Control"), c("Critical", "Individual")) # planned comparisons
compare_s1.pass.all <- list(c("Critical", "Control"), c("Critical", "Individual"), c("Control", "Individual")) # all comparisons
compare_s1.pass.ccrit <- c("Critical", "Control") # pairwise comparison
compare_s1.pass.icrit <- c("Critical", "Individual") # pairwise comparison

# s2 ---------------------------
compare_s2 <- list(c("Critical", "Naive")) 
compare_s2.all <-c("Critical", "Naive") # all comparisons
compare_s2.ncrit <-c("Critical", "Naive") # pairwise comparison

# s3 ---------------------------
compare_s3 <- list(c("Critical", "Control"), c("Critical", "Individual"), c("Critical", "Naive")) # planned comparisons
compare_s3.all <- list(c("Critical", "Control"), c("Critical", "Individual"), c("Critical", "Naive"), c("Control", "Individual"),  c("Control", "Naive"), c("Individual", "Naive"))  # all comparisons
compare_s3.ccrit <- c("Critical", "Control") # pairwise comparison
compare_s3.icrit <- c("Critical", "Individual") # pairwise comparison
compare_s3.ncrit <-c("Critical", "Naive") # pairwise comparison
```

```{r race_hist.perc_s1.pass}
race_hist.perc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>% 
    count(race.f = factor(race.f)) %>% 
    mutate(pct = prop.table(n)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = race.f, y = pct, label = scales::percent(pct))) + 
    geom_col(position = 'dodge') + 
    geom_text(position = position_dodge(width = .9),    # move to center of bars
              vjust = -0.5,    # nudge above top of bar
              size = 3.5) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(add = c(0, .2))) + 
  labs(x = " ", 
       y = "Frequency", 
       title = "Racial/ethnic Identity") +
  apa.angle_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
```

## Duration {.tabset .unnumbered}

```{r duration-aov-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# SAVE ANOVA --------------
duration_aov_s1.pass <- lm(duration ~ condition.f, data = s1.pass)

# COMPARISONS W/ESTIMATES' EFFECT SIZES --------------
duration_est_s1.pass <- flexplot::estimates(duration_aov_s1.pass) 

# SAVE POST-HOC --------------
duration_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(duration ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = duration_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# SAVE EMMEANS --------------
duration_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(duration_pwc_s1.pass)

# SAVE RESULTS --------------
duration_aov.apa_s1.pass <- papaja::apa_print(duration_aov_s1.pass) # for reporting stats
# duration_aov.apa_s1.pass$statistic$modelfit
# apastats::describe.mean.sd(s1.pass$duration, dtype = "c")

duration_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(duration_aov_s1.pass)  %>% 
  tidy(duration_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

duration_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(duration ~ condition.f, data = s1.pass) # for adding stats to plot
# labs(caption = rstatix::get_test_label(pun_aov.test_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE, row = 1))
```

```{r duration-aov-table-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# ANOVA TABLE --------------
duration_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANOVA Table of Duration by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F) # %>% row_spec(c(1:2), background = "#FFFACD")
```

```{r duration-diff-table-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Group Differences of Study Duration by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Comparison", "Difference", "Lower", "Upper", "Cohen's d")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F) # %>% row_spec(c(1:2), background = "#FFFACD")
```

```{r duration-emm-table-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# EMMEANS TABLE --------------
duration_emm.cond_s1.pass[, 1:6] %>%  
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Estimated Marginal Means of Study Duration by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Condition", "EMM", "SE", "df", "Conf.low", "Conf.high")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F)
```

## Punitive Support {.tabset .unnumbered}

Participants were asked rate the extent to which they oppose or favor four items on a scale from 1 (strongly oppose) to 4 (strongly favor):

* PUN_COPS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_cops)`
* PUN_JAILTIME: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_jailtime)`
* PUN_PENALTY: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_penalty)`
* PUN_PRISONS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_prisons)`


```{r pun-models-s1.pass}
# SAVE ANOVA --------------
pun_aov_s1.pass <- lm(punitive.c ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

# SAVE POST-HOC --------------
# planned comparisons
pun_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>% rstatix::emmeans_test(punitive.c ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = pun_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# all comparisons
pun_pwc_s1.pass.all <- s1.pass %>% rstatix::emmeans_test(punitive.c ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Control", covariate = condition.f, model = pun_aov_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# SAVE COMPARISONS W/ESTIMATES' EFFECT SIZES --------------
pun_est_s1.pass <- lm(punitive.c ~ condition.f + political + female + race.f + age + edu3.f + adj_income, data = s1.pass)
pun_est_s1.pass <- flexplot::estimates(pun_est_s1.pass)  # doesn't work with the centered IVs

# SAVE EMMEANS --------------
pun_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(pun_pwc_s1.pass)

# SAVE RESULTS --------------
pun_aov.apa_s1.pass <- papaja::apa_print(pun_aov_s1.pass) # for reporting stats
# pun_aov.apa_s1.pass$statistic$modelfit
# apastats::describe.mean.sd(s1.pass$pun, dtype = "c")

pun_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(pun_aov_s1.pass) %>% 
  tidy(pun_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

pun_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(pun_aov_s1.pass) # for adding stats to plot
# caption = # rstatix::get_test_label(model, detailed = TRUE, row = 1) condition coefficient is first
```

```{r pun-pol3-contrast-s1.pass, fig.cap = "Planned Contrasts of Punitive Policy Support by Political Orientation in Study 1", eval = TRUE}
pun.pol3_ols_s1.pass <- lm(punitive.c ~ condition.f * political3.f + female + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

# liberals

# moderates

# conservatives
```

#### Pairwise {.active}

```{r pun-cops-violin-stats-s1.pass}
pun.cops_violin.stats_s1.pass <- ggplot(s1.pass, aes(x = condition.f, y = pun_cops, fill = condition.f)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", color = "black", alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(-0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$pun_cops), 40),
    y = NULL,
    x = "Condition", caption = "Note: Simple pairwise comparisons with crossbar representing group means."

    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fills_s1.pass) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_s1.pass) + 
  apa.stats_theme + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1), 
                 geom = "crossbar", width = 0.1 ) + 
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = compare_s1.pass
                        , position = "identity"
                        , test = "t.test"
                        , map_signif_level = function(p) sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
                        , y_position = max(s1.pass$pun_cops)
                        , step_increase = 0.15
                        , margin_top = .05
                        , vjust = -0.4
                        , textsize = 5
                        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:4, expand = expansion(add = c(.5, .5))) + 
  EnvStats::stat_mean_sd_text(geom = "text"
                              , size = 5
                              , text.box = TRUE
                              , y.pos = (min(s1.pass$pun_cops)*.5)
                              , digits = 2
                              , digit.type = "round")
ggsave(filename="/Users/cintiahinojosa/Box/Booth PhD/Gun Violence Dissertation/dissertation-book/images/pun.cops_violin.stats_s1.pass.png", pun.cops_violin.stats_s1.pass, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 500)
```

## Restorative Support {.tabset .unnumbered}

Participants were asked rate the extent to which they oppose or favor four items on a scale from 1 (strongly oppose) to 4 (strongly favor):

 * REST_BANBOX: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_banbox)`
 * REST_YOUTH: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_youth)`
 * REST_JOBS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_jobs)`
 * REST_FEDAID: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_fedaid)`

### Distributions

```{r rest-dist-s1.pass}
# HISTOGRAM WITH MEAN
rest_hist_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = restorative)) + 
    geom_histogram(bins = 8, fill = "gray", col = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = favor4
    , y = "Frequency"
    , title = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$restorative), 70)
       ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 4), breaks = c(1:4)) + 
  apa.dist_theme +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(s1.pass$restorative), col = "red", lwd = 1) # Add line for mean
ggsave(filename="/Users/cintiahinojosa/Box/Booth PhD/Gun Violence Dissertation/dissertation-book/images/rest_hist_s1.pass.png", rest_hist_s1.pass, width = 6 , height = 6, dpi = 500)

# HISTOGRAM BY CONDITION
rest_hist.cond_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = restorative, fill = as.factor(condition.f))) + 
    geom_histogram(bins = 8, col = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = favor4
    , y = "Frequency"
    , title = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$restorative), 70)
    , fill = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$condition.f), 70)
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 4), breaks = c(1:4)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fills_s1.pass) +
  apa.dist_theme
ggsave(filename="/Users/cintiahinojosa/Box/Booth PhD/Gun Violence Dissertation/dissertation-book/images/rest_hist.cond_s1.pass.png", rest_hist.cond_s1.pass, width = 6 , height = 6, dpi = 500)

# HISTOGRAM FACETS BY CONDITION
rest_hist.facet_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = restorative, fill = as.factor(condition.f))) + 
    geom_histogram(bins = 8, col = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = favor4
    , y = "Frequency"
    , title = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$restorative), 70)
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 4), breaks = c(1:4)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fills_s1.pass) +
  apa.dist_theme  +
```

### ANCOVA

```{r rest_aov_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# CONTRASTS --------------
# contrasts(s1.pass$condition.f) <- contr.sum
# contrasts(s1.pass$race.f) <- contr.sum
# contrasts(s1.pass$edu3.f) <- contr.sum

# ANCOVA --------------
rest_aov_s1.pass <- lm(restorative.c ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

rest_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(restorative.c ~ political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c + condition.f, data = s1.pass) # for plotting stats

rest_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(rest_aov_s1.pass, type="III")  %>% 
  tidy(rest_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
rest_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANCOVA Table of Restorative Policy Support in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# POST-HOC --------------
rest_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(restorative.c ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = rest_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
rest_pwc_s1.pass[, c(3:4, 6:14)] %>% 
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Contrasts of Restorative Policy Support by Condition in Study 1"
         # #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
        ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# EMMEANS --------------
rest_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(rest_pwc_s1.pass)

# TABLE
rest_emm.cond_s1.pass[, 1:6] %>%  
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Estimated Marginal Means of Restorative Policy Support by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Condition", "EMM", "SE", "df", "Conf.low", "Conf.high")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)
```

```{r rest-contrast.all-s1.pass-old, eval = FALSE}
                  , caption = "All Contrasts of Restorative Support by Condition in Study 1"

  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F) #%>%  kable_styling(font_size = 13)#row_spec(c(4,6), background = "#FFFACD")

# all contrasts effect sizes

rest_eff.cond_s1.pass <- as.data.frame(emmeans::eff_size(rest_emm.cond_s1.pass, sigma = sigma(rest_ols_s1.pass), edf = rest_ols_s1.pass$df.residual, method = "pairwise"))

                  , caption = "Effect Sizes of All Contrasts on Restorative Support by Condition in Study 1"

  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F) #%>%   kable_styling(font_size = 13)#row_spec(c(4,6), background = "#FFFACD")

# all conditions main effect
rest_emm.cond_s1.pass <- emmeans(rest_ols_s1.pass, ~ condition.f)
rest_contrast.cond_s1.pass <- emmeans::contrast(rest_emm.cond_s1.pass, adjust = "mvt")

                  #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
                  , caption = "All Effects of Condition on Restorative Support in Study 1"
                  ) %>%
```

```{r rest-banbox-violin-stats-s1.pass}
rest.banbox_violin.stats_s1.pass <- ggplot(s1.pass, aes(x = condition.f, y = rest_banbox, fill = condition.f)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", color = "black", alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(-0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = wrap.labels(sjlabelled::get_label(s1.pass$rest_banbox), 40),
    y = NULL,
    x = "Condition", caption = "Note: Simple pairwise comparisons with crossbar representing group means."
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fills_s1.pass) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_s1.pass) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1), geom = "crossbar", width = 0.1 ) + 
  apa.stats_theme + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1), 
                 geom = "crossbar", width = 0.1 ) + 
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = compare_s1.pass
                        , position = "identity"
                        , test = "t.test"
                        , map_signif_level = function(p) sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
                        , y_position = max(s1.pass$rest_banbox)
                        , step_increase = 0.15
                        , margin_top = .05
                        , vjust = -0.4
                        , textsize = 5
                        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:4, expand = expansion(add = c(.6, .6))) + 
  EnvStats::stat_mean_sd_text(geom = "text"
                              , size = 5
                              , text.box = TRUE
                              , y.pos = (min(s1.pass$rest_banbox)*.3)
                              , digits = 2
                              , digit.type = "round")
ggsave(filename="/Users/cintiahinojosa/Box/Dissertation-Proposal/images/rest.banbox_violin.stats_s1.pass.png", rest.banbox_violin.stats_s1.pass, width = 7 , height = 7, dpi = 500)
```

### ANCOVA

```{r sr.s_aov_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# CONTRASTS --------------
# # contrasts(s1.pass$condition.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$race.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$edu3.f) <- contr.sum

# ANCOVA --------------
sr.s_aov_s1.pass <- lm(sr.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

sr.s_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(sr.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass) # for plotting stats

sr.s_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(sr.s_aov_s1.pass ,type="III")  %>% 
  tidy(sr.s_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sr.s_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANCOVA Table of Symbolic Racism in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# POST-HOC --------------
sr.s_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(sr.s ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = sr.s_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sr.s_pwc_s1.pass[, c(3:4, 6:14)] %>% 
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Contrasts of Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
         #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
        ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# EMMEANS --------------
sr.s_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(sr.s_pwc_s1.pass)
```

## FACTOR ANALYSES {.tabset .unnumbered}

### All Policies

 * PUN_COPS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_cops)`
 * PUN_JAILTIME: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_jailtime)`
 * PUN_PENALTY: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_penalty)`
 * PUN_PRISONS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$pun_prisons)`
 * REST_BANBOX: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_banbox)`
 * REST_YOUTH: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_youth)`
 * REST_JOBS: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_jobs)`
 * REST_FEDAID: `r Hmisc::label(s1.pass$rest_fedaid)`

```{r policies_fa.test_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# create group with items
policies_vars_s1.pass <- dplyr::select(s1.pass, pun_cops, pun_jailtime, pun_penalty, pun_prisons
                                  , rest_banbox, rest_youth, rest_jobs, rest_fedaid
                                  )

# correlation matrix
policies_cormat_s1.pass <- cor(policies_vars_s1.pass, use = "complete.obs") 

# Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin factor adequacy analysis (suggests FA if  KMO ≥ 60)
psych::KMO(policies_cormat_s1.pass) #Overall MSA = 

# Bartlett’s Test of Sphericity (suggests FA if p 0<.05)
psych::cortest.bartlett(policies_vars_s1.pass) #

# calculate the determinant of a matrix (suggests FA if positive)
det(cor(policies_vars_s1.pass)) #
```

```{r policies_fa.parallel_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# parallel factor analysis using correlation matrix
psych::fa.parallel(policies_cormat_s1.pass, n.obs = nrow(s1.pass), fa = "both", fm = "ml"
                   , main = "Parallel Factor Analysis: All Policies (Study 1)"
```

### Punitive

```{r pun_fa.test_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# create group with items
punitive_vars_s1.pass <- dplyr::select(s1.pass, pun_cops, pun_jailtime, pun_penalty, pun_prisons)

# correlation matrix
pun_cormat_s1.pass <- cor(punitive_vars_s1.pass, use = "complete.obs") 

# Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin factor adequacy analysis (suggests FA if  KMO ≥ 60)
psych::KMO(pun_cormat_s1.pass) #Overall MSA = 0.87; seize and tech > 0.91

# Bartlett’s Test of Sphericity (suggests FA if p 0<.05)
psych::cortest.bartlett(punitive_vars_s1.pass) #0

# calculate the determinant of a matrix (suggests FA if positive)
det(cor(punitive_vars_s1.pass)) #0.01627296
```

#### ANCOVA

```{r sri.s_aov_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# CONTRASTS --------------
# # contrasts(s1.pass$condition.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$race.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$edu3.f) <- contr.sum

# ANCOVA --------------
sri.s_aov_s1.pass <- lm(sri.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

sri.s_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(sri.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass) # for plotting stats

sri.s_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(sri.s_aov_s1.pass ,type="III")  %>% 
  tidy(sri.s_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sri.s_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANCOVA Table of Internal Symbolic Racism in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# POST-HOC --------------
sri.s_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(sri.s ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = sri.s_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sri.s_pwc_s1.pass[, c(3:4, 6:14)] %>% 
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Contrasts of Internal Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
         #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
        ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# EMMEANS --------------
sri.s_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(sri.s_pwc_s1.pass)

# TABLE
sri.s_emm.cond_s1.pass[, 1:6] %>%  
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Estimated Marginal Means of Internal Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Condition", "EMM", "SE", "df", "Conf.low", "Conf.high")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)
```

#### ANCOVA

```{r sre.s_aov_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# CONTRASTS --------------
# # contrasts(s1.pass$condition.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$race.f) <- contr.sum
# # contrasts(s1.pass$edu3.f) <- contr.sum

# ANCOVA --------------
sre.s_aov_s1.pass <- lm(sre.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

sre.s_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(sre.s ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass) # for plotting stats

sre.s_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(sre.s_aov_s1.pass ,type="III")  %>% 
  tidy(sre.s_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sre.s_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANCOVA Table of External Symbolic Racism in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# POST-HOC --------------
sre.s_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(sre.s ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = sre.s_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
sre.s_pwc_s1.pass[, c(3:4, 6:14)] %>% 
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Contrasts of External Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
         #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
        ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# EMMEANS --------------
sre.s_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(sre.s_pwc_s1.pass)

# TABLE
sre.s_emm.cond_s1.pass[, 1:6] %>%  
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Estimated Marginal Means of External Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Condition", "EMM", "SE", "df", "Conf.low", "Conf.high")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)
```

```{r pun-sri_med_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
pun.sri_medfitY_s1.pass <- lm(punitive ~ critical + sri.c + political + female + race.f + age.c + adj_income.c + edu3.f, data = s1.pass) #IV and M on DV; pun.sri_med1_s1.pass
```

#### ANCOVA

```{r antiblack_aov_s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# CONTRASTS --------------
# contrasts(s1.pass$condition.f) <- contr.sum
# contrasts(s1.pass$race.f) <- contr.sum
# contrasts(s1.pass$edu3.f) <- contr.sum

# ANCOVA --------------
 antiblack_aov_s1.pass <- lm(antiblack.c ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass)

 antiblack_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(antiblack.c ~ condition.f + political + female.f + race.f + age.c + edu3.f + adj_income.c, data = s1.pass) # for plotting stats

 antiblack_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(antiblack_aov_s1.pass ,type="III")  %>% 
  tidy(antiblack_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
 antiblack_aov.summ_s1.pass %>%
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "ANCOVA Table of Symbolic Racism in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Term", "SS", "df", "Statistic", "p")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# POST-HOC --------------
 antiblack_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(antiblack.c ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = antiblack_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# TABLE
 antiblack_pwc_s1.pass[, c(3:4, 6:14)] %>% 
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Contrasts of Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
         #, col.names = c("Contrasts", "Est.", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
        ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)

# EMMEANS --------------
 antiblack_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(antiblack_pwc_s1.pass)

# TABLE
 antiblack_emm.cond_s1.pass[, 1:6] %>%  
kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Estimated Marginal Means of Symbolic Racism by Condition in Study 1"
      , col.names = c("Condition", "EMM", "SE", "df", "Conf.low", "Conf.high")
      ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), full_width = F, font_size = 13)
```

```{r fed-aov-s1.pass, eval = TRUE}
# SAVE ANOVA --------------
fed_aov_s1.pass <- lm(fed ~ condition.f + political + female + race.f + age + edu3.f + adj_income, data = s1.pass)

# SAVE POST-HOC --------------
fed_pwc_s1.pass <- s1.pass %>%
  rstatix::emmeans_test(fed ~ condition.f, ref.group = "Critical", covariate = condition.f, model = fed_aov_s1.pass, comparisons = compare_s1.pass, detailed = TRUE
    , p.adjust.method = "fdr"
    ) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

# SAVE EMMEANS --------------
fed_emm.cond_s1.pass <- rstatix::get_emmeans(fed_pwc_s1.pass)

# SAVE RESULTS --------------
fed_aov.apa_s1.pass <- papaja::apa_print(fed_aov_s1.pass) # for reporting stats
# fed_aov.apa_s1.pass$statistic$modelfit
# apastats::describe.mean.sd(s1.pass$fed, dtype = "c")

fed_aov.summ_s1.pass <- car::Anova(fed_aov_s1.pass)  %>% 
  tidy(fed_aov.summ_s1.pass) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

fed_aov.test_s1.pass <- rstatix::anova_test(fed ~ condition.f, data = s1.pass) # for adding stats to plot
```

```{js, echo = FALSE}
(function() {
  var codes = document.querySelectorAll('pre:not([class])');
  var code, i, d, s, p;
  for (i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) {
    code = codes[i];
    p = code.parentNode;
    d = document.createElement('details');
    s = document.createElement('summary');
    s.innerText = 'Details';
    // <details><summary>Details</summary></details>
    d.appendChild(s);
    // move the code into <details>
    p.replaceChild(d, code);
    d.appendChild(code);
  }
})();
```
